pages.title: Real Surgeon Simulator Game
pages.creator: Nexifie L.L.C
pages.description: Real Surgeon Simulator Game puts you in charge of diagnosing patients and performing operations in a virtual hospital. Use medical tools to carry out surgical tasks and respond to emergency cases across different departments. The game presents its hospital work as doctor missions, combining patient diagnosis with treatment and surgery.

pages.title: Cat arrows: Cozy Puzzle
pages.creator: UnitedITForce
pages.description: Cat arrows: Cozy Puzzle asks you to release cats from a crowded maze in the correct order. Tap an unblocked cat to send it in its facing direction. Clear every cat from the board, using hints and view controls when the paths become tangled.

pages.title: Hidden Paint 3D
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Hidden Paint 3D turns a search for listed objects into a coloring activity. Explore each scene and tap the required items to paint them in bright shades. Complete the task list to finish the location and move into another environment to color.

pages.title: Hard Puzzle
pages.creator: Playgama
pages.description: Hard Puzzle challenges you to assemble a square from colorful geometric pieces. Examine their outlines and fit the shapes together until they form the complete target. Unlock harder arrangements as you progress, with a hint available when a piece's position is unclear.

pages.title: Traffic Tap Survival
pages.creator: GameBerry Studio
pages.description: Traffic Tap Survival puts you in charge of vehicles crossing busy intersections. Tap a car to send it along the direction marked on it, timing the release around other traffic. Guide every vehicle past obstacles and through the junction without causing a crash.

pages.title: Hidden Object - Girl and Cat
pages.creator: Starodymov Games
pages.description: Hidden Object - Girl and Cat follows a girl searching the forest after Lassie runs away. Examine the scenes and collect the listed objects as you look for the missing cat. Complete the searches to continue the girl's journey toward finding her companion.

pages.title: Emergency Jam
pages.creator: Inlogic Software
pages.description: Emergency Jam asks you to clear a parking lot using emergency vehicles of different sizes and colors. Move each car in its permitted direction and collect passengers matching its color as it exits. Use sorting or shuffle boosters to unblock difficult arrangements.

pages.title: CS: Chaos Squad
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: CS: Chaos Squad pits two five-player teams against one another in tactical shooting battles. Move, aim, and work with teammates while buying weapons and equipment between rounds. Adapt the loadout to the next confrontation as the ranking system records individual and team performance.

pages.title: Horror Playtime Room Escape
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Horror Playtime Room Escape traps you in a frightening room after a birthday celebration goes wrong. Explore connected rooms, inspect clues, and solve puzzles to uncover a way out. Use the objects and information you find to continue through the mystery.

pages.title: People Playground 3d
pages.creator: jimo game
pages.description: People Playground 3d lets you build physics-driven battles between red and blue teams. Arrange fighters, obstacles, and explosive objects to create a scenario, then watch the ragdolls collide. Change the setup and experiment with barriers to see how another confrontation unfolds.

pages.title: Moto Attack Bike Racing
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Moto Attack Bike Racing combines motorcycle competition with attacks on rival riders. Drive through the tracks and use weapons against opponents while avoiding pedestrians, taxis, boxes, and other obstacles. Balance the racing route with the combat as you try to move ahead.

pages.title: Load The Dishes ASMR
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Load The Dishes ASMR turns loading a dishwasher into a sorting puzzle. Organize dishes by color and place the groups into the machine in a useful order. Complete the arrangement while the cleaning-themed activity plays its accompanying dish-handling sounds.

pages.title: End Of World
pages.creator: GamePush
pages.description: End Of World sends you into a post-apocalyptic landscape collecting coins and searching for unlockable items. Spend money on objects held inside blue glass spheres or summon monster waves for additional earnings. Keep enemies at a distance as you explore and expand the available equipment.

pages.title: Block Craft 3d
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Block Craft 3d puts you in a block-built world with a base to defend and monsters outside. Fight enemies for diamonds, build protective structures, and use bombs to alter the terrain. Spend the collected diamonds to unlock stronger weapons for the next expedition.

pages.title: Stickman Jailbreak Story
pages.creator: AdelikDev
pages.description: Stickman Jailbreak Story asks you to help a prisoner escape through object-choice puzzles. Inspect the rooms and select items that can overcome the obstacles to freedom. Use each tool in the right situation, since an incorrect choice can end the stickman's attempt.

pages.title: WormsArena.io
pages.creator: RHM Interactive
pages.description: WormsArena.io drops you into a snake arena filled with food. Gather bait to grow, use boosts to reposition, and trap opponents so they fail. Earn coins for new snake designs while chasing the highest score and the crown awarded to the arena leader.

pages.title: Space Strike: Galaxy Shooter
pages.creator: Crazy Pixel
pages.description: Space Strike: Galaxy Shooter sends your spaceship against waves threatening different planets. Steer through the battles, fire on enemy formations, and activate the ultimate attack when needed. Defend and liberate the space locations by clearing the opposing groups along the route.

pages.title: Rapid Rush
pages.creator: Instant Games Studio
pages.description: Rapid Rush uses one button to steer through an endless course. Hold the left mouse button to change direction, then release to return to the original heading. Collect coins during the run and unlock the boy and truck characters for later attempts.

pages.title: School Puzzle Book
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: School Puzzle Book gathers several activity-game types into one collection. Match objects to shadows, aim in bubble-shooting puzzles, and work through swapping and memory challenges. Try the different pages and raise your score while switching between their separate puzzle mechanics.

pages.title: Word Search Simulator
pages.creator: GamingStars
pages.description: Word Search Simulator gives you letter boards containing hidden vocabulary. Scan the grid, find a word, and select its letters to remove the answer from the search list. Continue until every required term has been discovered in the current puzzle.

pages.title: Uphill Rush 12
pages.creator: Azerion Casual Games
pages.description: Uphill Rush 12 puts you in a car on an arcade route to the finish. Accelerate along the course and tilt the vehicle during jumps to perform stunts. Reach the end quickly while keeping the car from landing upside down and ending the run.

pages.title: Monster Reform
pages.description: Monster Reform challenges you to survive against powerful creatures in a three-dimensional shooter. Move, crouch, and switch firearms while clearing the attacking monsters. Eliminate the full group to open another map, then prepare for enemies that grow stronger with each level.

pages.title: Soccer Bubble Shooter
pages.creator: BestGamesFreePlay.com
pages.description: Soccer Bubble Shooter asks you to fire football-shaped bubbles into matching color groups. Form clusters of at least three to remove them from the playing area. Aim for larger clears and try to finish the whole arrangement using fewer shots.

pages.title: Half And Half Celebrity Style
pages.creator: Cutedressup
pages.description: Half And Half Celebrity Style lets you create split-style outfits for celebrity characters. Mix clothing pieces to produce contrasting halves within one coordinated look. Work through the wardrobe choices and prepare the celebrities to show their new combinations during a night out.

pages.title: Tank Zombies 3D
pages.creator: Yizhiyuan Network Technology Co., Ltd.
pages.description: Tank Zombies 3D puts you in control of armored survivors fighting an undead takeover. Drag to move the tanks through the zombie swarms and keep battling the advancing threat. Improve the units as you progress to face enemies that steadily gain strength.

pages.title: Fireman Rescue Maze
pages.creator: PuzzleGame.Com
pages.description: Fireman Rescue Maze casts you as a firefighter entering buildings with people trapped inside. Navigate the maze, avoid obstacles, and extinguish the fires blocking the route. Bring the survivors out safely while working through the different rescue layouts.

pages.title: Candy Link
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Candy Link challenges you to clear pairs of identical sweet-themed tiles against a countdown. A connecting line can turn no more than twice, so blocked routes require another pair first. Find available matches and remove the entire board before time expires.

pages.title: Hex bomb Megablast
pages.creator: Playtouch
pages.description: Hex bomb Megablast combines block breaking with aimed ball shots. Blast falling hexagons before they reach the bottom of the field. Hold the screen to slow the shooting action and adjust the aim, then release to send the next shot into the blocks.

pages.title: Among Impostors
pages.creator: Meyagames
pages.description: Among Impostors asks you to expand a team by collecting food around the arena. Take bonuses such as shields and speed boosts while watching the size of opposing groups. Stay clear of larger enemies that can swallow your team, and build enough numbers to become stronger.

pages.title: Hero 4 Slice Enemies
pages.creator: GoGoMan
pages.description: Hero 4 Slice Enemies gives you claws and throwing strength in a city occupied by hostile fighters. Strike enemies directly, grab and throw them, or use a circular attack against surrounding groups. Face armored giants and keep moving while damaged opponents continue to pursue you.

pages.title: DOP 2 Delete One Part
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: DOP 2 Delete One Part presents picture riddles that can be solved by removing a detail. Drag the eraser across the part hiding the answer or causing the problem. Reveal the correct change to finish the current scene and open another puzzle.

pages.title: Arrow Challenge
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Arrow Challenge has you guide a growing stack of arrows toward guards waiting at the finish. Build the arrow supply as you move along the course. Reach the end with enough projectiles to knock down every guard and complete the stage.

pages.title: Muscle Run
pages.creator: DAB3Games
pages.description: Muscle Run sends a strengthening runner through courses filled with breakable barriers. Build up muscle, smash smaller obstacles, and steer clear of the dangerous ones. Keep the character moving through each level until you reach the finish of the obstacle run.

pages.title: Math Merge
pages.creator: trezegames
pages.description: Math Merge asks you to drag numerical pieces together on a grid. Work with categories including Roman numerals, fractions, Mayan symbols, polygons, and ordinary numbers. Complete mathematical challenges to earn additional pieces or coins while continuing to merge the available values.

pages.title: Snake Swipe Puzzle
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Snake Swipe Puzzle challenges you to guide a soft-bodied block snake through a maze. Swipe along a route that covers the required path with the snake's body. Plan the turns so the remaining sections can still be reached as you fill the layout.

pages.title: Pixel Archer Save The Princess
pages.creator: magnificstudios
pages.description: Pixel Archer Save The Princess sends an archer through rescue puzzles with enemies and mechanisms in the way. Fire carefully at levers to help free the princess. Consider the positions of the warriors and balloons while choosing shots through each arrangement.

pages.title: Yellow Balls
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Yellow Balls asks you to launch a stream of balls upward from the yellow point at the bottom. Time the firing so they reach the target above. React to the changing setup and choose when to send the next group along its straight vertical path.

pages.title: Bus Simulator 2021
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Bus Simulator 2021 gives you bus-driving activities focused on parking and passenger pickup. Control the large vehicle with keyboard steering and guide it into the required positions. Work through the driving situations while handling the bus carefully around its stopping and parking tasks.

pages.title: Garbage Sanitation Truck
pages.creator: CarGames.Com
pages.description: Garbage Sanitation Truck has you drive between rubbish bins and a processing site. Load the trash at the collection point, then transport it to the disposal area for unloading. Complete each level's route while avoiding collisions with other vehicles on the road.

pages.title: Zombie Vacation
pages.creator: G55.CO
pages.description: Zombie Vacation strands a special-forces soldier on a tropical island after a plane crash. Use a submachine gun to hold off the zombies crowding the area. Move and jump through the fighting, surviving each wave to complete the island's combat challenge.

pages.title: Addition Practice
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Addition Practice lets you solve sums in a format resembling written arithmetic. Choose the time setting and practice calculations with or without carrying. Enter the answers using mouse or touch controls and work through the selected addition problems.

pages.title: Linear Basketball
pages.creator: FTG
pages.description: Linear Basketball asks you to draw ramps that guide moving balls into baskets. Sketch a path beneath each ball and adjust the route when multiple hoops appear. Block or divert bombs so they do not follow the basketballs into the scoring targets.

pages.title: Bricks Master
pages.creator: QkyGames
pages.description: Bricks Master challenges you to send a ball through breakable bricks while avoiding red blocks. Choose the correct movement or tap action as the arrangement changes. Keep the ball away from the dangerous colored pieces to continue clearing further levels.

pages.title: Pipeline 3D Online
pages.creator: YAD.Com
pages.description: Pipeline 3D Online asks you to restore water to a wilting flower. Tap pipe sections to rotate them and build a continuous connection from the hydrant. Work out the correct orientation of each piece so the supply reaches the plant at the end.

pages.title: Children Games
pages.creator: Mikhail Shalyagin
pages.description: Children Games gathers simple activities including balloon popping, matching shapes to shadows, and remembering card positions. Choose a challenge and complete it with one-touch interactions. Switch between the different puzzle types as you explore the collection's colorful learning-themed games.

pages.title: Funny Cars Memory
pages.creator: newgamess
pages.description: Funny Cars Memory gives you a short preview of vehicle pictures before the search begins. Remember their positions, then reveal matching images before time runs out. Work through the levels by recalling which funny car is hidden behind each tile.

pages.title: Traffic Racer2D
pages.creator: Fat Boy Studio
pages.description: Traffic Racer2D challenges you to steer a car through traffic without crashing. Move left or right to pass other vehicles, collect health, and take power-ups that increase your speed. Keep the car safe as the road ahead fills with potential collisions.

pages.title: Turtle Jump
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Turtle Jump sends a turtle upward through a series of platforms. Tap to climb, avoid enemies and spikes, and gather helpful items along the way. Bombs can clear enemies, while shields and jump boosters help the turtle reach higher scores.

pages.title: Silly Ways To Get Infected
pages.creator: TinyDobbins
pages.description: Silly Ways To Get Infected turns virus-awareness themes into quick action puzzles. Complete activities such as washing hands or avoiding unwanted touches before the short timer expires. React to the changing minigames as the pace increases and mistakes use up your remaining chances.

pages.title: Easter Jigsaw Deluxe
pages.creator: Lof Games
pages.description: Easter Jigsaw Deluxe offers seasonal pictures to reconstruct from scattered sections. Drag each piece into its exact position and match its details with the neighboring parts. Finish the full Easter illustration before continuing to another picture in the jigsaw collection.

pages.title: Cute Bike Coloring Book
pages.creator: MG Studio
pages.description: Cute Bike Coloring Book gives you drawings of bicycles and motorbikes to decorate. Choose colors and apply them across the vehicle's different sections. Create a separate palette for each road-going bike picture as you work through the available coloring pages.

pages.title: Baby Hazel Daycare
pages.creator: Baby Hazel
pages.description: Baby Hazel Daycare follows Hazel and Matt during their first visit to a childcare center. Help the nanny respond to the siblings' requests, feed them, and play games. Keep both children happy while helping them spend time with the other kids.

pages.title: Push Em All
pages.creator: BestGames
pages.description: Push Em All challenges you to clear enemies from platforms with a pushing tool. Move into position and shove the opposing groups toward the edges. Collect power-ups that extend the pushing reach as you work through the crowds blocking the route.

pages.title: Pixel Art Coloring Book
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Pixel Art Coloring Book offers four pixel-based pictures to decorate. Select a drawing, choose colors, and apply them to the image's individual areas. Create your own version of each piece of pixel art before moving on to another picture in the book.

pages.title: Crazy Ball 2
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Crazy Ball 2 sends a ball through twenty platforming stages on a star-collecting mission. Move across the levels and gather as many stars as possible. The game's weather system changes the setting while you continue working through the different courses.

pages.title: Vector Christmas Puzzle
pages.creator: WillingGames.com
pages.description: Vector Christmas Puzzle offers six festive character images with four jigsaw difficulties each. Pick sixteen, thirty-six, sixty-four, or one hundred pieces for the selected picture. Drag the sections into place until the complete Christmas illustration is restored.

pages.title: Ninja
pages.creator: Bnagames
pages.description: Ninja asks you to guide a running character through a cave. React to the obstacles along the route and keep the ninja clear of them using mouse or touch controls. Continue moving safely through the underground course as the run unfolds.

pages.title: Sand Balls
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Sand Balls challenges you to create a route that carries a group of balls to the finish. Use the mouse to open a path around or through obstacles. Choose the route carefully so as many balls as possible reach the destination together.

pages.title: Port Truck Parking
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Port Truck Parking puts you to work positioning trucks around a busy-looking port setting. Steer into the required spaces and use the handbrake and camera controls to manage tight approaches. Complete more than a hundred parking stages to prove your handling of the large vehicles.

pages.title: Horse Show Jump Simulator 3D
pages.creator: 8Games.Net
pages.description: Horse Show Jump Simulator 3D lets you take a horse through riding and jumping activities. Mount the animal, select among three riding speeds, and use jumps to handle the course. Practice controlling the horse through the challenges of the riding championship.

pages.title: Brain Twister
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Brain Twister challenges you to discover the exact order of colors in a hidden sequence. Drag balls into positions and try arrangements that use each color only once. Work out which value belongs in each slot to finish the current color-code puzzle.

pages.title: Words Jungle
pages.creator: FG Studio
pages.description: Words Jungle asks you to make as many words as possible from the supplied letters. Try different combinations and enter answers with the mouse or keyboard. Keep looking for unused arrangements to increase the word total from the current letter set.

pages.title: Hidden Star Emoji
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Hidden Star Emoji hides star-shaped emoji details throughout its scenes. Examine each picture and click the concealed stars when you find them. Locate the full set required by the level to move into another image and continue the hidden-object search.

pages.title: Balance Tall V
pages.creator: Nj developer Studio
pages.description: Balance Tall V asks you to jump onto arriving blocks and keep a growing tower balanced. Time the landings to reach a greater height without losing the character. Avoid nearby obstacles while trying to improve the score from the stacking challenge.

pages.title: Fun Hidden Objects
pages.creator: Fun Best Games
pages.description: Fun Hidden Objects gives you six timed scenes with lists of items to find. Search each picture and select the requested objects before the countdown ends. Click carefully, since repeated mistakes take an additional five seconds from the time available.

pages.title: Royal Wedding Guests
pages.creator: MGS
pages.description: Royal Wedding Guests helps Bonnie and Mia prepare to attend a wedding in London. Choose elegant clothing for the two princesses and complete their guest outfits. Add suitable hats as a finishing detail before they leave for the royal celebration.

pages.title: Hidden Treasure
pages.creator: New Kids Games
pages.description: Hidden Treasure sends you to a small island searching for buried pirate wealth. Choose places to investigate and try to locate the chest before your limited moves are spent. Plan where to search next rather than using the whole allowance without finding the treasure.

pages.title: Dragon Queen Wedding Dress
pages.creator: DL-studio
pages.description: Dragon Queen Wedding Dress asks you to style a silver-haired queen for her wedding. Choose a white gown, shoes, and accessories, then arrange her hair in a bridal braid. Complete the outfit to prepare the dragon queen for the ceremony.

pages.title: Cowboy Dash
pages.creator: Webgameapp
pages.description: Cowboy Dash mixes running, jumping, and shooting along a route filled with enemies and obstacles. Fire at threats while collecting coins during the journey. Spend the earnings to unlock more guns and try to improve the distance reached on the next run.

pages.title: Pirates Treasure
pages.creator: Gemini Games
pages.description: Pirates Treasure is an island search puzzle about finding hidden loot. Select covered spots to reveal what they contain and locate the treasure. Choose where to look next as you work through the game's sequence of searching levels.

pages.title: Mouse Jump Challenge
pages.creator: Vi Games
pages.description: Mouse Jump Challenge has you send a small mouse through jumps while collecting cheese. Click or tap to make the character leap toward the next pickup. Time the movement carefully and gather as many pieces of cheese as you can during the attempt.

pages.title: Police Parking
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: Police Parking offers twenty stages focused on placing a car correctly. Steer through each parking situation and bring the vehicle into its intended space. Work through the different layouts while practicing the controlled movement needed to finish each parking task.

pages.title: Choose Gravity
pages.creator: T
pages.description: Choose Gravity challenges you to guide a white ball by changing the direction of gravity. Tap to alter its path while keeping it clear of the red squares. Continue navigating through the hazards and try to improve the score from your survival attempt.

pages.title: City Driver
pages.creator: JulGames
pages.description: City Driver lets you explore a city and find a car to drive. Choose what to do around the urban environment and take the vehicle onto its roads. Follow your own route as you spend time driving through the city.

pages.title: Water Park Fun
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Water Park Fun follows a group of princesses shopping before a day at the pools. Visit the water park's store and choose swimsuits for the outing. Complete their holiday looks with accessories so the group is ready to enjoy the sunny day together.

pages.title: Stickmen Vs Zombies
pages.creator: kiz10.com
pages.description: Stickmen Vs Zombies challenges you to defend a city from an advancing undead horde. Build a stronger SWAT team and use it to hold back the attack. Make strategic decisions about the group as you work to stop the zombies from entering the city.

pages.title: Trollface vs Zombies
pages.creator: FREEGAMES66
pages.description: Trollface vs Zombies sends undead enemies toward Trollface from all four directions. Knock down each attacker before it reaches the character, since a single touch ends the game. React to the changing approach routes and try to defeat more zombies with each attempt.

pages.title: Money Movers 2
pages.creator: Agame
pages.description: Money Movers 2 brings the two brothers back to prison after their father asks for help escaping. Switch between the characters and guide them through the prison's obstacles. Bring both brothers to the exit as you work toward completing the family rescue.

pages.title: Wedding Preps
pages.creator: Oscar Intermed
pages.description: Wedding Preps helps an engaged couple choose between two wedding locations. Join their planner to decorate each venue and compare the finished settings. Arrange the available details before deciding where the couple will hold their celebration at the end of the preparations.

pages.title: Road Kill
pages.creator: Red Eye Production
pages.description: Road Kill challenges you to complete a dangerous driving course through interfering traffic. Keep the car moving while avoiding vehicles that try to slow its progress. Steer carefully through the road hazards and reach the end of the current level.

pages.title: Goldie Princess Toddler Feed
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Goldie Princess Toddler Feed turns breakfast into a care activity for a small child. Warm the milk, prepare cereal, and help Goldie feed the toddler. Use toys and kisses to keep the little one happy so the meal is finished before it gets cold.

pages.title: Cute Fishtail Braids
pages.creator: Unify Media Inc.
pages.description: Cute Fishtail Braids joins Jenny for a tutorial featuring three braided hairstyles. Choose a look and work through the hair-styling activities needed to create it. Follow the game's step-by-step presentation as you prepare one of the fishtail braid designs.

pages.title: Music Festival Couples Rivals
pages.creator: Games Banner Network
pages.description: Music Festival Couples Rivals helps Elsa and Jasmine prepare for a major music event with their boyfriends. Browse the wardrobes and choose clothing for the festival outing. Complete the looks with makeup as you get the princesses ready for the trip together.

pages.title: Couples Autumn Outfits
pages.creator: DariaGames.com
pages.description: Couples Autumn Outfits gives four characters a wardrobe of seasonal clothing to explore. Mix jackets, colorful scarves, and other pieces into coordinated looks for the lovers. Finish each outfit so the group is ready to go out together in the autumn weather.

pages.title: Ice Kingdom Coloring Book
pages.creator: SisiGames
pages.description: Ice Kingdom Coloring Book offers drawings of magical characters from a frozen kingdom. Choose shades from the palette and fill the different parts of each illustration. Continue through the pages, giving every character the color combination you want to create.
